events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect fix commit, origin/main, publish hold, worktrees
events.input: $ git fetch -q origin && git show --stat --oneline b698339d | head -20 && git branch -r --contains b698339d | head; git log --oneline -1 origin/main; grep -n -i "publish held" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -5; git worktree list | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show fix diff and compare against origin/main
events.input: $ grep -n -i "held\|lifted\|unheld" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -4; git show b698339d -- app/scripts/probe-onboarding-tabs.mjs app/scripts/walk-ui.mjs app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts; for f in app/scripts/probe-onboarding-tabs.mjs app/scripts/walk-ui.mjs app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts; do echo "== $f"; git diff --stat origin/main b698339d -- $f; done; git log --oneline origin/main -3; git merge-base --is-ancestor b698339d^ origin/main && echo parent-on-main

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check whether origin/main has the dependent pieces
events.input: $ git grep -c "ev_platform\|d2-live-room-zoom" origin/main -- app/src app/scripts | head; git show origin/main:app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts | grep -n -A2 'id: "d2-content-schedule"'; git show origin/main:app/scripts/probe-onboarding-tabs.mjs | grep -n 'Next →' | head

events.text: Origin/main still has the broken schedule link and the old probe. Building the clean worktree and cherry-picking only the code files.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Create clean worktree and cherry-pick fix without committing
events.input: $ W=/Users/adithyamurali/t467-fix; [ -e $W ] && echo EXISTS && exit 1; git worktree add -q --detach $W origin/main && cd $W && git cherry-pick -n b698339d 2>&1 | tail -3; git status --short | head;

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect existing t467-fix worktree
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/t467-fix && git status --short | head; git log --oneline -3; cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && git worktree list | grep t467

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check prior cherry-pick status and uncommitted diff
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/t467-fix && git merge-base --is-ancestor 58a7a73c origin/main && echo ON-MAIN || echo not-on-main; git log --oneline 58a7a73c..origin/main | wc -l; git show --stat --oneline 58a7a73c | tail -5; git diff | head -40

events.name: Bash
events.head: Rebase the cherry-pick onto latest origin/main
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/t467-fix && git stash -q && git rebase -q origin/main 2>&1 | tail -3; git stash pop -q; git log --oneline -2; git status --short; ls app/node_modules >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo nm-ok; ls -la app/node_modules 2>/dev/null | head -1

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate check scripts and dev config
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/t467-fix/app && ls scripts | grep -E "check-guides|probe-details|probe-onboarding-tabs|probe-headings|probe-visual-tools|check-rail-pins"; grep -n -E '"(dev|build|export)' package.json; head -30 scripts/probe-onboarding-tabs.mjs | grep -n -i "base\|url\|port" | head

events.text: Run the static checks first, and start a dev server on a free port for the browser probes.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run static checks in the clean worktree
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/t467-fix/app && for s in check-guides check-rail-pins probe-headings probe-visual-tools; do echo "=== $s"; node scripts/$s.mjs 2>&1 | tail -3; echo "exit $?"; done; echo "=== probe-details"; node scripts/probe-details.mjs 2>&1 | tail -4; lsof -ti:4391 | head -1
